title: Grateful Dead Live at KMPX Radio Show on 1967-04-01
lineage: Pre-FM-MR > R > DAT > CDR > EAC (secure) > Cool Edit (remove gaps) > CD Wave (retrack) > mkwACT > SHN (seekable)

ai_review.summary: A pristine archival radio broadcast that gives a rare look at Jerry & Phil’s 1967 musical influences, captured with clear audio and lively banter.
ai_review.review: This recording is an invaluable snapshot of early San Francisco free‑form FM radio, featuring Tom Donahue alongside Jerry Garcia and Phil Lesh as they discuss and play the music that shaped them. Reviewers praise the eclectic playlist—from blues classics to avant‑garde classical—and the candid conversation, noting the audio quality is solid enough for easy listening. The overall vibe is enthusiastic and historically rich.

ai_rating.rationale: The vast majority of reviews are 5‑star, highlighting both the historical value and good audio quality; only one neutral comment about a broken link does not affect the overall assessment.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Listeners repeatedly mention clear download quality and crisp sound; no major drop‑outs or distortion are reported.

standout_songs: Sittin' On Top Of The World
show_quality.setlist_flow: An eclectic, tightly sequenced mix of blues, folk, jazz, soul and avant‑garde classical that reflects the band’s wide‑ranging influences; interspersed with engaging banter and commentary.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Described as engaged and insightful, offering personal anecdotes (e.g., Otis Redding story); one reviewer notes he sounds a bit slurred but still enthusiastic.
band_member_comments.Phil: Praised for intelligent commentary and deep knowledge; occasionally noted as slightly slurred in the broadcast.
